newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Surry 1 nuclear unit at full power.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Surry 1 nuclear unit at full power.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 1 nuclear power unit has returned to 100 percent of capacity after restarting this past weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
The unit, in Gravel Neck, Va., was operating at about 77 percent power early Monday after shutting down on Friday, January 24, due to a steam pipe leak.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources Inc.
